psalm-50-1.verse: The Mighty One, God, the Lord, has spoken, And summoned the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.
psalm-50-1.prayer: Lord, You are the mighty God who speaks with authority. Help me listen carefully and respond faithfully to Your voice.

psalm-50-2.verse: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone forth.
psalm-50-2.prayer: Father, Your glory shines with perfection. Help me recognize Your majesty and worship You with reverence.

psalm-50-3.verse: May our God come and not keep silence; Fire devours before Him, And it is very tempestuous around Him.
psalm-50-3.prayer: Lord, thank You that You are holy and just. Help me live in a way that honors Your righteousness.

psalm-50-4.verse: He summons the heavens above, And the earth, to judge His people:
psalm-50-4.prayer: Father, You see all things and judge perfectly. Help me live with integrity before You.

psalm-50-5.verse: “Gather My godly ones to Me, Those who have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
psalm-50-5.prayer: Lord, thank You for calling Your people into relationship with You. Help me remain faithful to the covenant You have established through Christ.

psalm-50-6.verse: And the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself is judge. Selah.
psalm-50-6.prayer: Father, Your judgments are true and righteous. Help me trust Your wisdom in all things.

psalm-50-7.verse: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak; O Israel, I will testify against you; I am God, your God.
psalm-50-7.prayer: Lord, give me ears to hear Your instruction and a heart willing to obey.

psalm-50-8.verse: I do not reprove you for your sacrifices, And your burnt offerings are continually before Me.
psalm-50-8.prayer: Father, remind me that You desire more than outward actions—you desire a heart devoted to You.

psalm-50-9.verse: I shall take no young bull out of your house Nor male goats out of your folds.
psalm-50-9.prayer: Lord, help me remember that everything belongs to You and that You are not dependent upon anything I can offer.

psalm-50-10.verse: For every beast of the forest is Mine, The cattle on a thousand hills.
psalm-50-10.prayer: Father, thank You as the Creator and Owner of all things. Teach me to be a faithful steward of what You have entrusted to me.

psalm-50-11.verse: I know every bird of the mountains, And everything that moves in the field is Mine.
psalm-50-11.prayer: Lord, You know every detail of creation and every detail of my life. Thank You for Your care and attention.

psalm-50-12.verse: If I were hungry I would not tell you, For the world is Mine, and all it contains.
psalm-50-12.prayer: Father, remind me that You are completely self-sufficient and worthy of worship simply because of who You are.

psalm-50-13.verse: Shall I eat the flesh of bulls Or drink the blood of male goats?
psalm-50-13.prayer: Lord, help me understand the true meaning of worship and devotion to You.

psalm-50-14.verse: Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving And pay your vows to the Most High;
psalm-50-14.prayer: Father, let gratitude and thanksgiving become a regular part of my life and relationship with You.

psalm-50-15.verse: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I shall rescue you, and you will honor Me.”
psalm-50-15.prayer: Lord, thank You for inviting me to call upon You in times of trouble. Help me trust You completely.

psalm-50-16.verse: But to the wicked God says, “What right have you to tell of My statutes And to take My covenant in your mouth?
psalm-50-16.prayer: Father, help me not merely speak Your truth but live it faithfully every day.

psalm-50-17.verse: For you hate discipline, And you cast My words behind you.
psalm-50-17.prayer: Lord, reveal areas where I resist correction and give me a teachable and humble heart.

psalm-50-18.verse: When you see a thief, you are pleased with him, And you associate with adulterers.
psalm-50-18.prayer: Father, keep me from compromising with sin and help me walk in obedience to Your Word.

psalm-50-19.verse: You let your mouth loose in evil And your tongue frames deceit.
psalm-50-19.prayer: Lord, guard my speech and help my words reflect truth, grace, and wisdom.

psalm-50-20.verse: You sit and speak against your brother; You slander your own mother’s son.
psalm-50-20.prayer: Father, protect my relationships and help me treat others with kindness, honesty, and love.

psalm-50-21.verse: These things you have done and I kept silence; You thought that I was just like you; I will reprove you and state the case in order before your eyes.
psalm-50-21.prayer: Lord, forgive me when I make assumptions about You that are not true. Help me know You as You have revealed Yourself.

psalm-50-22.verse: “Now consider this, you who forget God, Or I will tear you in pieces, and there will be none to deliver.
psalm-50-22.prayer: Father, help me remember Your warnings and respond to them with repentance and faith.

psalm-50-23.verse: He who offers a sacrifice of thanksgiving honors Me; And to him who orders his way aright I shall show the salvation of God.”
psalm-50-23.prayer: Lord, let my life be marked by thanksgiving, obedience, and worship that glorifies You.

psalm-50-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for Your holiness, justice, and mercy. Help me worship You not only with my words but also with my life. Teach me to walk in obedience, gratitude, and sincerity before You. Guard my heart from hypocrisy, strengthen my faith, and help me trust You in every circumstance. May my life continually bring honor and glory to Your name through genuine worship and faithful devotion.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
